Biotech brand with no consumer awareness.

Innovent Biologics is a Chinese biopharmaceutical company, based in Suzhou, that develops and sells antibody-based medicines for cancer, metabolic and autoimmune diseases, including Tyvyt (sintilimab) and weight-loss drug mazdutide. Kodiak Sciences is a Palo Alto, California clinical-stage biotechnology company developing treatments for retinal diseases such as wet age-related macular degeneration and diabetic eye disease, using its antibody biopolymer conjugate platform, including tarcocimab tedromer. Rhythm Pharmaceuticals is a Boston biopharmaceutical company that markets Imcivree (setmelanotide) for rare genetic forms of obesity, including POMC deficiency and Bardet-Biedl syndrome, and is developing it for hypothalamic obesity. TTEC is a customer experience technology and services company, with its headquarters shown as Austin, Texas, that provides contact centres, digital customer engagement, AI-enabled support and consulting to large enterprises in health care, telecoms, retail and technology. B2B outsourcing brand with no consumer profile.

Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical is a Novato, California biopharmaceutical company specialising in rare and ultra-rare genetic diseases, with marketed medicines such as Crysvita for X-linked hypophosphatemia, Mepsevii, Dojolvi and Evkeeza (ex-US), and gene therapy candidates in development. Specialist pharma brand with no consumer awareness.

Vera Therapeutics is a Brisbane, California clinical-stage biotechnology company developing atacicept for IgA nephropathy and other immune-mediated kidney diseases, which it sought US approval for.
